nom: medicube 3H Overnight Drying Lotion for Targeted Spot Care

avis.texte: This stuff is a miracle in a bottle! I got it for my 12 year old son who's face is really breaking out in his T zone. It's hard enough to get him to shower, much less do any type of face routine right now. Let the formula sit for a minute - let it separate - then put a qtip down the hole - and dab right onto your pimple(s). He was scared the first time i put it on him, so he only let me do half - overnight his acne was no longer red and was almost just like dry skin he could flake off - the next night i used it again and his face is almost clear! to my knowledge it doesn't sting or anything on him - i just made sure he let it dry before he went to bed and we were amazed when he woke up! I'm actually excited to get a pimple myself to see if it works as well on my old skin as it does on his!! I will absolutely buy this over and over if/when it runs out.

I have hormonal acne that I hate and that can be deep. I also have a hard time not picking at it and trying to get it out. This stuff is amazing. I put it on as the last step of my skin care routine and have never felt any irritation but that also means there could be a good layer of products between my skin and this product. That being said it also hasn’t interacted negatively to any of my other skin care products. I only use it at night. It dries quickly and I just leave it on. By the next morning I always see a significant difference in the size, redness, irritation and pressure of the acne spot. This will remain a staple in my skin care routine.
Seems to work ok. Idk if massive zits will be gone as well. Used on myself and son and it so far seems ok. Does have a cold and stingy feeling at first but isn't bad just didn't expect it at first.

It definitely works, but it leaves white residue in the pores. It doesn’t come off with water, it’s down deep in the pores and looks like little white dots. I don’t have particularly large pores. Granted it goes away after a day or so, but that’s annoying. Don’t think I’ll be ordering this again.
I LOVE THIS STUFF I USE IT EVERY NIGHT SHRINKS PIMPLES OVERNIGHT USE CONSISTENLY EVERY NIGHT IT WORKS SO WELL I PROMISE
Used it exactly once and saw results. As someone with moderate inflamed acne this really smoothed my face. It does have a slight sting to it but nothing crazy
I’ve had horrible chin acne and this really cleared it up. I no longer have breakouts on my chin anymore after using this product!

avis.titre: Really works and a little goes a long way
avis.texte: I love this product! It has calamine lotion and really does dry up the acne really fast. I could see a significant change the next day. A little goes a long way!

avis.titre: Best drying lotion I have tried yet!
avis.texte: For reference, I have combo skin (oily t-zone and dry chin/cheeks), with hormonal acne. I use tretinoin roughly 3-4 days per week to help with the hormonal acne on my, chin and jawline, this has caused me to have some dry patches in those areas. I do not have sensitive skin or eyes, as I can use direct acids and most fragrances without irritation. I also have some slight pitting from acne scaring. I prefer unscented or lightly scented products and light weight/gel textured products when possible. Medicube NEVER FAILS ME!! I absolutely love this Overnight Drying Lotion. I have been using the Eradikate Drying Lotion, but that is $30 and Medicube is $15, great value! I love the design of this bottle as well, it makes it easier to not spill and to get the excess off the qtip. I do not feel like this dying lotion dries out the skin around my acne, which is a step up from what I was using before. This helps my cystic acne feel much better by the next morning. If you have had a cystic acne spot, you know how badly they can hurt. It also helps the scab heal faster when I have given in and popped my pimples instead of wearing a patch. I cannot even feel this on my skin. There is a strong alcohol smell, but no Sulphur smell, and the smell goes away as soon as it dries down, which is almost immediately. If you are looking for a drying lotion that will not break the bank, this is the one!

avis.titre: Drying lotion that really helps calm my acne
avis.texte: I’ve tried a lot of spot treatments over the years, and this is one of the few that actually made a noticeable difference overnight. The medicube 3H Drying Lotion works really well at calming down angry breakouts and reducing redness by the next morning. I especially like that it helps dry out spots without making my skin feel painfully dry or flaky afterward. The formula feels soothing thanks to the calamine and tea tree ingredients, and it’s great for those deep under-the-skin blemishes that usually take forever to go away. It doesn’t have an overwhelming fragrance and it’s super easy to use with a cotton swab. I also appreciate that a little goes a long way, so even the small bottle lasts longer than expected. The packaging feels high quality, which is a nice bonus. Overall, this has become one of my go-to skincare products whenever I feel a breakout starting. Definitely worth trying if you have oily or acne-prone skin and want something effective but still gentle.

avis.titre: Superior version of an old favorite
avis.texte: This was such a throwback product for me! I’ve thankfully aged out of regular breakouts, but my daughter is just getting into that phase where things seem to appear overnight, everything from little whiteheads to those big, stubborn closed comedones that literally look angry. So I figured I’d introduce her to the same style of drying lotion I used as a teen. And yes, it’s the classic no-shake, pink powder-in-alcohol situation. You dip a Q-tip straight down into the bottom layer and dab it on. Very nostalgic. The ingredient list is exactly what you’d expect from this category, with a few upgrades. Alcohol is the base, which helps dry out the lesion and keeps the formula antimicrobial. Calamine (zinc oxide + iron oxides) is doing a lot of the heavy lifting in terms of calming inflammation and reducing redness. There’s also salicylic acid in there to help clear out pores and break down the buildup inside those deeper clogs. Sulfur shows up as well, which has both antibacterial and keratolytic properties, so it helps dry things out and speed up resolution. This ingredient mix means it works on whiteheads, comedones, and even blackheads. What makes this feel more modern is the addition of things like centella, beta-glucan, ceramide NP, and a few humectants. Those don’t turn it into a hydrating product by any means, but they do take the edge off so you’re not left with that angry, cracked halo around the spot the next morning. And it works. This is similar to another brand in that it's layered and you don't shake before using. You take a q-tip and dip it in then dot it where you need it to go. It does seem to be effective. I don't get pimples very often, but as luck would have it one popped up on my nose, of all places, and it was definitely smaller and less red the next day. I can't say it completely disappeared, but it was pretty close. This has an antiseptic smell to it because of the tea tree oil, but it goes away quickly and it wasn't overpowering to me but I'm not usually sensitive to smells. Tea tree oil is also antibacterial, so I see it as a plus. It's a little small for the price, but then again, for how much you apply each time it's going to last for months, which makes it pretty affordable.
I would put zero stars if I could. Burned my skin, do not use on cystic acne.

I’m a huge fan of Medicube products and recently had the opportunity to order and test the new 3H Overnight Drying Lotion. This product claims to target spot care for troubled and oily-prone skin with key ingredients like salicylic acid, centella asiatica, and calamine, BHA, niacinamide, betaine, camphor, hyaluronic acid, madecassoside acid. This is an impressive list of ingredients and a unique blend with the camphor and calamine - ones I don’t normally see in skincare. It has low irritant testing results and is non-comedogenic. It is silicone, sulfate and paraben free. It does contain oil, alcohol, is not EU-allergen-free, not fungal-acne-safe or reef safe. These do not concern me but are important to be aware of if you are sensitive to any of them. I was a little unsure of what the definition of trouble skin was and had to wing it a little. My 21 year old son lives at home and has acne prone and oily skin. I decided to use this on the few large developing pimples with big heads between his eyebrows and side of his nose. I followed the instructions, not shaking the bottle and reaching the bottom to get the powder on a q-tip, applying to the spots, and then he allowed it to dry and stay on his face overnight. The consistency of this is interesting - it’s a powdery liquid but I don’t see a powdery bottom layer. Nonetheless, I followed the directions and applied. avis.titre: Like the Cult-Favorite Mario Badescu — But I Actually Like This One Better
avis.texte: I’m 52 and post-menopausal with dry, mature skin, so I don’t deal with breakouts as often as I used to — but when I do, I want something that’s effective without being overly harsh or drying. This Medicube 3H Overnight Drying Lotion really impressed me. If you’re familiar with the Mario Badescu Drying Lotion (the cult classic), this is very similar in concept — but honestly, I like this one better. First, it works. When I apply this directly to a spot at night, I usually notice that by morning the area looks calmer, less red, and less inflamed. It doesn’t completely erase everything overnight, but it definitely speeds up healing in a noticeable way. What makes this one stand out for me is that it feels gentler and more skin-friendly, which is important for mature skin. Some drying lotions can be too aggressive and leave the surrounding area flaky or irritated. This one helps calm breakouts without making my skin feel overly dry. I also like the ingredient combination here — calamine, centella, and tea tree — which makes it feel more soothing while still being effective. It’s a nice balance between treatment and calming care. The texture is exactly what you expect from a drying lotion — you dip a cotton swab into the pink sediment and apply directly to the spot. It’s easy to use and dries quickly. Another plus is that a little goes a long way, so even though the bottle looks small, it should last quite a while. That makes this a good value, especially considering how effective

avis.titre: The ultimate "reset button" for sensitive skin flare-ups
avis.texte: As a regular product tester with highly sensitive skin, I frequently deal with inflammation and irritation from new formulas. This product has been an absolute lifesaver. If you’re old enough to remember the scent of calamine lotion from childhood (the chicken pox remedy), you’ll recognize the smell and the pink tint from this bottle immediately. I was able to test the product upon arrival because of a cluster of red, irritated blemishes that had been lingering for three days. I applied a small dab directly onto the infected area, and it dried rather quickly onto my skin, anlmost immediately after applied as if I hadn't applied any product at all. That is how light weight it feels and quickly it dries onto the skin. By the next morning, the irritation was completely gone with no visible signs of redness. I tried it again on the other side where I had a similar breakout with the same overnight results. It’s rare to find something that works this fast on active inflammation. If your skin is reactive like mine, this belongs in your permanent skincare "first aid kit."

avis.titre: Sorry for the gross picture but someone had to do it
avis.texte: I can’t meaningfully upload another picture of a bottle, because I’m sure ALL of my other Vine peers will go ahead and do exactly that 🫠 So please go ahead and enjoy my photo of the product in action, yuck!!! (But hey, it’s working!!) This overnight drying lotion is super effective but there’s a catch. Obviously post-delivery, this item was super shaken up and I couldn’t test it right away. This product should NOT be shaken, and you will need qtips to dip in to grab the solution that settles at the bottom of the bottle. I applied this to my most recent flare up and it dried almost immediately. There was a bit of redness surrounding my pimple but that settled down after about 20minutes passed since applying it. Hours later the size of my pimple had shrunken quite a lot. The “lotion” does have a really strong chemical smell, but it’s soooo much better than that nasty bottle of Kate Somerville stuff. Bleeeech that stuff is NASTY. If you are looking for a treatment that targets flare ups and you do NOT have sensitive skin I would highly recommend this product. Please avoid excessive sun-exposure while using though or you will be in for a sunburn asap.

avis.titre: An affordable blemish treatment that works!
avis.texte: Medicube products usually deliver good results. The 3H drying lotion does indeed deliver. The pink drying lotion is designed to be used as an overnight spot treatment. Easy to apply with a cotton bud. The directions advise not to shake the bottle, so the calamine powder separates from the liquid. In addition to the calming Calamine, skin friendly Centella and Tea Tree leaf oil are ingredients. The scent is slightly chemical smelling. Not the calamine scent of my youth. I don’t believe it would be offensive, if used for spot treatments. The lotion dries quickly and completely. Leaving no chalky residue to transfer to my pillow case. I also appreciate the safety seals on the box and bottle.

This arrived at just the right time. I have a breakout on my forehead, so was able to use this as soon as I opened it. Not sure it's supposed to work this fast, but it's only been four hours now, and I can already see a difference. The pimple is starting to dry out and crust over. Yay! Keep in mind that I also try to pop my pimples first so that the acne lotion gets in there and starts doing it's thing. Something I learned from Tyra Bank's top model show. This drying lotion has a light pink color, is a loose thin liquid, and has a nice light scent. It comes in a glass jar with an opening on top, so you can dap it on your finger and apply with little to no mess or waste. This is my first time using the Medicube brand, but I've seen influencers talking about other products of theirs on social media. Glad I got to see what the hype is all about. Definitely worth the money.

This spot cream is kind of like others but more refined. This one is not like the usual spot treatment; it is more stable and does not separate as much and makes it easy to get a good amount of product more consistently. It is very calming on the skin and reduces the inflammation and redness very well. I haven't had the crusty peeling skin issue either that other spot treatments cause every morning. I recommend only using at night so it has time to work and absorb overnight.

This drying lotion works well on acne spots. It has a sediment at the bottom that you have to allow to settle before applying. You then dip a cotton swab into the sediment and apply to your spot. I noticed that it dried it out overnight and my spots were considerably smaller the next day. There are a few other brands that make this kind of product but I think this one is the best. I would recommend for overnight spot care.

This has a nice calming effect on any irritated pimples. I put it on in the evening before bedtime and rinsed it off in the morning, and I definitely noticed a difference in that irritation on my face. It dries them out and calms the skin surrounding any acne. It is very easy to use too. You just take a Q-tip and dip it down into the bottom of the container and pull it out and apply. No smell of any sort. Very happy with this.

This spot treatment really works! I used it on a breakout overnight and noticed a big improvement by morning. It helped reduce redness and dry out the blemish without making my skin feel irritated or overly dry. A little goes a long way, and it’s super easy to apply. It’s definitely something I’ll keep in my skincare routine for quick, effective results.
